caption: : Eval PPL. under different Sub-Dim Numbers settings.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) of two models—Transformer and MoHD—under different settings of the number of sub-dimensions, with the x-axis representing the "Numbers of Sub-Dims" on a logarithmic scale ranging from 1632 to 256, and the y-axis showing Eval PPL values from 9.5 to 12.5. The Transformer model is represented by a red dashed line, which remains nearly constant at approximately 11.6 across all sub-dimension settings. The MoHD model is depicted by a blue solid line, which starts at around 10.4 when the number of sub-dims is 1632, increases slightly to about 10.7 at 64, then remains relatively stable at around 10.6 for 128 and 256 sub-dims. The shaded area between the two lines highlights the performance gap between the models, with MoHD consistently achieving lower perplexity than Transformer across all tested configurations.
